leaves.name: gaudronRemondThm14AnDeg
leaves.doc: gr-isogdeg, printed form: Gaudron-Remond, Duke Math. J. 163 (2014) Thm 1.4 (p. 2060; kappa and alpha(g) = 1024 g^3 p. 2058; read by the locator audit), over ZInQ.R3Residual.IsAnStableHeight, with the degree of the isogeny as a finite morphism: ZInQ.GRIsogDeg.finDeg phi = Mathlib's Scheme.Hom.finrank of phi at the generic point of the target (= [K(A):K(B)]). Replaces gaudronRemondThm14An (r3-residual's leaf, which bounds isogDeg = #ker(Kbar)) via ZInQ.GRIsogDeg.gaudronRemondThm14An_of_deg and isogDeg_le_finDeg (#ker(phi)(Kbar) <= finDeg phi for every isogeny over any field). The leaf is proved equivalent to r3-residual's GaudronRemondThm14An (ZInQ.GRIsogDeg.gaudronRemondThm14AnDeg_iff_an, from isogDeg_eq_finDeg in characteristic 0), so it is never stronger.
leaves.flag: unread: new printed leaf (Gaudron-Remond 2014 Thm 1.4 restated verbatim over IsAnStableHeight with the printed isogeny degree [K(A):K(B)] = Scheme.Hom.finrank at the generic point, gr-isogdeg); locator UNVERIFIED
